entry.name: hubBaseUrl
entry.label: Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, for example http://127.0.0.1:8123. The widget calls GET /api/states/<entity_id> and POST /api/services/switch/<service>.

entry.name: pollIntervalSeconds
entry.label: How often the widget reads its entities from Home Assistant, in seconds. One GET request is made per tracked entity.

entry.name: walletName
entry.label: KWallet wallet that holds the Home Assistant long-lived token.

entry.name: walletFolder
entry.label: KWallet folder that holds the Home Assistant token entry.

entry.name: walletKey
entry.label: KWallet entry key that holds the Home Assistant token. The token itself is never entered in this configuration page.

entry.name: tecla1SwitchEntity
entry.label: Home Assistant switch entity for key 1. This is the only entity the key writes.

entry.name: tecla1BulbEntities
entry.label: Comma-separated light entities that key 1 drives. Display-only: the Home Assistant automation writes them.

entry.name: tecla2SwitchEntity
entry.label: Home Assistant switch entity for key 2. This is the only entity the key writes.

entry.name: tecla2BulbEntities
entry.label: Comma-separated light entities that key 2 drives. Display-only: the Home Assistant automation writes them.

entry.name: iconOn
entry.label: Panel icon while the keys are on (any name from the active theme).

entry.name: iconOff
entry.label: Panel icon while the keys are not on (any name from the active theme).

entry.name: iconUnknown
entry.label: Panel icon while the state is unknown, unavailable or mixed, so an unreadable state never looks "off" (any name from the active theme).
